scope: Four matched Poisson seeds. Each pair uses the same 8232-source ordering and starts at rest. Compare all-neuron phase counts, frozen visual-pool spike rates and potential traces, checking that the entire pre-phase is identical within each pair. No fitting, trial removal, dose search, success selection or inference of living-animal replication. Source count/order differs from the earlier isolated experiment, so its trial counts are not paired controls.

background.mapping: Exact existing odor-probe clean-air rule: each atlas baseline (missing = 0) times 150 Hz, held throughout pre/on/off. This scale is an assumed model input, not a measured received odor dose.

limitations: Existing clean-air ORN background remains on in all phases; no added odor.
Poisson source rate is an assumed model input, not physical light intensity.
The inherited model uses spikes for transmission and starts at rest without tonic drive.
Voltage and spike responses are model outputs, not calcium signals, wing motion or living-fly predictions.
